plugin.name: fnOS Manager
plugin.description: Manage fnOS devices through fnos-cli: system info, storage, files, Docker, download tasks, apps, logs, monitoring, network, users, and Baidu Netdisk.
panel.title: fnOS Manager
panel.subtitle: Connect, authorize, and manage your fnOS device
panel.launcher.missingDetail: The launcher is unavailable, so the plugin cannot run commands. Make sure the scripts/ directory ships with the plugin and check the plugin log.
panel.connection.title: Connection & Authorization
panel.connection.tip: Authorization is two steps: click "Begin authorization" to sign in in the browser, then paste back the one-time code shown on the page. The code is valid for 5 minutes and can be used once.
panel.confirmLogout: Clear the local session for this profile? Server-side tokens are not revoked.
panel.login.pendingHint: Open the link below in a browser and sign in, then paste back the one-time code shown on the page. The code is valid for 5 minutes and can be used only once.
panel.login.codeHelp: The string shown on the browser page. Do not include extra spaces or line breaks.
panel.config.title: Save config
panel.config.tip: These values are plugin-level defaults; entries can override host/port/scheme/profile per call.
panel.fields.hostHelp: Use localhost for loopback, an IP or domain for LAN. Leave empty to reuse the CLI's saved target.
panel.fields.profileHelp: Sessions are isolated per profile; letters, digits, _ - . only.
panel.fields.timeoutHelp: Maximum execution time per command, 5-3600 seconds.
panel.fields.workingDirHelp: Leave empty to use the plugin runtime directory. Only set this when a specific local path is needed.
panel.placeholders.workingDir: Empty uses the default runtime directory
panel.quick.title: Read-only shortcuts
panel.quick.description: These commands only read device state and never change configuration.
panel.command.title: Run command
panel.fields.commandHelp: Without the fnos-cli prefix, e.g. storage pools. Write operations ask for confirmation first.
panel.command.tip: Commands are split with shell word rules and passed as an argv array; no shell evaluation happens.
panel.last.title: Last execution
panel.last.empty: No command has been run yet.
panel.errors.actionUnavailable: This action is unavailable right now. Make sure the plugin is running.
panel.errors.timeoutRange: Timeout must be an integer between 5 and 3600.
panel.errors.loginFailed: Could not generate the authorization link. Check the connection settings.
panel.errors.codeRequired: Paste the one-time authorization code shown in the browser first.
panel.errors.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the link and copy it manually.
panel.messages.linkGenerated: Authorization link generated. Finish sign-in in the browser.
fields.code: One-time authorization code from the user
fields.command: Command string without the fnos-cli prefix

entries.status.name: Connection status
entries.status.description: Show launcher availability, platform info, and current default connection settings. Does not contact the device.
entries.loginBegin.name: Begin OAuth authorization
entries.loginBegin.description: Generate an fnOS authorization link. Hand the link to the user to sign in, collect the one-time code, then call login_finish.
entries.loginFinish.name: Finish OAuth authorization
entries.loginFinish.description: Complete sign-in with the one-time code the user sent back. Must use the same host, system user, profile, and connection settings as login_begin. The code works once.
entries.logout.name: Sign out
entries.logout.description: Clear the local session for the current profile. Server-side tokens are not revoked.
entries.run.name: Run an fnos-cli command
entries.run.description: Run one fnos-cli command such as system info, storage overview, monitor cpu, or file ls /vol1/downloads. Write operations require confirmed=true. The command is split with shell word rules and passed as argv; no shell evaluation happens.
entries.systemInfo.name: System info
entries.systemInfo.description: Read static system identity: machine type, version, and volumes. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.storageOverview.name: Storage overview
entries.storageOverview.description: Read storage pools, disks, and capacity totals. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.storagePools.name: Storage pools
entries.storagePools.description: List storage pools (uuid / trim_* identifiers). Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.storageDisks.name: Disks
entries.storageDisks.description: List physical disks (bare device names). Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.monitorCpu.name: CPU monitor
entries.monitorCpu.description: Read CPU time-series metrics. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.monitorMemory.name: Memory monitor
entries.monitorMemory.description: Read memory time-series metrics. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.downloadList.name: Download tasks
entries.downloadList.description: List download tasks. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
entries.dockerStats.name: Docker status
entries.dockerStats.description: Read overall Docker status. Read-only, no confirmation needed.
fnos.confirm_write: This is a write operation that changes fnOS device state: {command}. Proceed?
fnos.confirm_logout: Clear the local session for profile {profile}?
fnos.login_no_url: No authorization link found in the CLI output; check host/port and device connectivity.
fnos.login_begin_summary: Open the authorization link in a browser, sign in, then send the one-time code back to me.
fnos.login_done: Signed in; the token is stored in the CLI-controlled store. Use system info for a read-only check.
fnos.code_required: Missing the one-time authorization code from the user.
